title: Lyft & Disneyland Good Neighbor Hotels: Save on Rides
summary: Staying at a Disneyland Good Neighbor Hotel this summer? Get 50% off two rides or 10% off an XL ride with Lyft. Offer runs through Sept 8, 2026.
body_markdown:
**Your Ride to the Magic Just Got a Little More Magical**


Summer at Disneyland® Resort is already peak happiness — the kind with churros, Mickey ears, and the undeniable chaos excitement of waiting in line for Space Mountain. And getting *to* the parks?We’re here to add a little magic to that journey, too


That's why we teamed up with Disneyland Resort to make the journey a little easier — with a few special deals in store — for guests staying at participating Good Neighbor Hotels this summer.


**What's the deal?**


If you're among the many guests staying at one of Disneyland Resort's participating Good Neighbor Hotels this summer, Lyft has a discount with your name on it:


-


**New to Lyft?** Use code **50MAGIC** for 50% off two rides.


-


**Already a Lyft rider?** Use code **XL10** for 10% off one XL ride to the parks.


The promotion runs now **May 28 through September 8, 2026** — right through the heart of summer travel season.


**Why it matters**


Good Neighbor Hotels can be a smart choice for Disney families — Good Neighbor Hotels offer quality accommodations that are located near the Disneyland Resort - You're sure to find one that fits your family’s travel style, size and budget!


And Lyft, is a transportation option that puts you in control. Request a ride when *you're* ready — whether that's before the park opens, after the fireworks, or for that mid-afternoon hotel break that every Disney parent knows is a survival strategy, not a defeat.


**A few things to note**


Discounts apply to rides between[Good Neighbor Hotels](https://disneyland.disney.go.com/en-ca/hotels/good-neighbor/) and Disneyland Resort. Standard Lyft terms and conditions apply.


Ready to ride? Download the Lyft app, enter your code, and get to the magic.
